name: Connected Conditioning-Minimal Non-Ample Classes
summary: Conditioning-minimal non-ample classes whose one-inclusion graphs are connected; equivalently, tope graphs of non-free simple uniform oriented matroids.
comments: Connectedness removes exactly the two-concept parallel rank-one exception from the full conditioning-minimal non-ample class. Every member has at least three concepts and an irredundant isometric hypercube embedding.
